text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the final 
hurdle of the Classic Triple Crown, has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, Bright. They say the Kikuka Sho 
is a race won by the "strongest" Umamusume 
of the Triple Crown—in other words, the 
one with true ability.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Deception will not work here. Believe in 
yourself and compete with true skill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, Lady McQueen. I will certainly run 
the way you taught me...
Hold on a second!

Suddenly, a loud voice echoed throughout 
the underground tunnel.

It's not simply the strongest Umamusume 
who wins the Kikuka-sho. To put it 
plainly—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The "lucky" Umamusume will win! Lucky girl 
Matikane Fukukitaru, here at your 
service—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Lady Fukukitaru~. So you are 
running in this race as well~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I set my sights on this Kikuka Sho 
as our destined race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance races are just like 
sugoroku! And when you think of sugoroku, 
you think of dice! Which means the roll of 
the dice is all down to luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In other words, today's all down to luck! 
*Ahem!*

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have never heard of the Kikuka Sho being 
a matter of luck...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then what is most important for the Nippon 
Derby, which they say is won by the 
"luckiest" Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's luck!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What about the Satsuki Sho, said to be won 
by the "fastest" Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's luck!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, it is entirely down to 
"luck"?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No, luck it is! As long as you have 
luck, you can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san, I will face you fair and 
square, relying purely on luck!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. I look forward to working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer-sama?
choice_data_list:
The Fukukitaru you see now doesn't just 
rely on luck.

The Fukukitaru I am now isn't just relying 
on luck, you know!

text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a fair warning: this 
autumn, Matikanefukukitaru's growth has 
been remarkable.

"With her honed, razor-sharp finishing 
kick, she takes consecutive, dominant wins 
in her prep races. Though she calls it 
luck, judging by those powerful strides, 
she is clearly entering her prime..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall prepare myself thoroughly. 
After all, I consider her a truly splendid 
opponent.

Against this fully bloomed incarnation of 
sheer luck, how far will Mejiro Bright's 
slumbering stayer talent take her?
